title: The Intern Who Said Yes

pre.en: What does Maya say when Chen asks her for help at the end?
pre.zh: 故事最后小陈找 Maya 帮忙，她怎么回答？
options: She can't help him this week.
She is too fed up with her job.
She needs his help with her own demo first.

intro: 一个关于「不会拒绝」的职场小故事：实习生 Maya 什么都答应，结果越忙越乱，小陈被请去帮她。读的时候留意定语从句：someone who …、the bug which …、her desk, where … 把「哪个人、哪个东西、哪个地方」直接接在名词后面说清楚；也看看小陈教她的那句客气的拒绝。

sentences.en: Our new intern, Maya, is someone who says yes to everything.
sentences.zh: 我们新来的实习生 Maya，是个什么都答应的人。

sentences.en: "Shall I book the meeting room?"
sentences.zh: 「要我去订会议室吗？」

sentences.en: "I'll fix that bug tonight!"
sentences.zh: 「那个 bug 我今晚就修！」

sentences.en: "No problem, I'll do it straight away!"
sentences.zh: 「没问题，我马上去办！」

sentences.en: In her first week, she took on every job that anyone mentioned.
sentences.zh: 来的第一周，谁提到什么活儿她都接。

sentences.en: She even offered to do the slides for a client demo.
sentences.zh: 连给客户演示用的幻灯片，她都主动揽了过去。

sentences.en: Soon she was working until midnight, and she still couldn't keep her promises.
sentences.zh: 很快她就天天干到半夜，可答应的事还是做不完。

sentences.en: The bug which she was going to fix "tonight" was still there on Friday.
sentences.zh: 她说「今晚就修」的那个 bug，到周五还在那儿。

sentences.en: And booking the meeting room slipped her mind, so the team had their stand-up in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 订会议室的事她也忘了，大家只好挤在茶水间开站会。

sentences.en: So Rachel, who's in charge of the interns, asked me to have a word with her.
sentences.zh: 于是负责带实习生的 Rachel 让我去跟她聊聊。

sentences.en: I video-called Maya at her desk, where she was surrounded by sticky notes.
sentences.zh: 我给 Maya 打了个视频电话，她坐在工位上，周围贴满了便利贴。

sentences.en: She insisted on finishing everything on her own.
sentences.zh: 她坚持所有事都要自己做完。

sentences.en: "I'm so fed up with myself," she said.
sentences.zh: 「我真受够我自己了，」她说。

sentences.en: "Have you ever said no to anyone here?" I asked.
sentences.zh: 「你在这儿拒绝过别人吗？」我问。

sentences.en: "Never."
sentences.zh: 「从来没有。」

sentences.en: "If I said no, they'd think I was lazy."
sentences.zh: 「我要是说不，大家会觉得我懒。」

sentences.en: "Well, you don't have to say yes to everything," I told her.
sentences.zh: 「可你用不着什么都答应啊，」我对她说。

sentences.en: Then I wrote a polite answer on a sticky note and held it up to the camera.
sentences.zh: 然后我在一张便利贴上写了一句客气的回答，举到镜头前。

sentences.en: "I'm afraid I can't this week."
sentences.zh: 「不好意思，这周恐怕不行。」

sentences.en: "The thing is, I'm already working on two other tasks."
sentences.zh: 「是这样的，我手上已经有两件事了。」

sentences.en: "And that's on top of the demo."
sentences.zh: 「这还不算那个演示。」

sentences.en: "And remember, asking for help isn't a crime," I added.
sentences.zh: 「还有，记住：找人帮忙又不犯法，」我补了一句。

sentences.en: A week later, she'd turned down four requests.
sentences.zh: 一周后，她已经推掉了四个请求。

sentences.en: She'd even taken a break for lunch.
sentences.zh: 甚至还停下来好好吃了顿午饭。

sentences.en: On Monday, I asked Maya to give me a hand with my demo.
sentences.zh: 周一，我请 Maya 帮我弄一下我的演示。

sentences.en: She gave me a kind smile.
sentences.zh: 她冲我客气地笑了笑。

sentences.en: "I'm afraid I can't this week, Chen."
sentences.zh: 「恐怕这周不行哦，小陈。」

sentences.en: Well, I'd taught her a bit too well.
sentences.zh: 好吧，看来是我教得太好了。

cards.note: 实习这份工作叫 internship；去实习是 do an internship。
to accept a job or a responsibility
cards.tip: 常说 take on too much（揽的活太多）；代词放中间：take it on。还有「招人」的意思：take on new staff。
cards.example: Don't take on more work than you can finish this sprint.

cards.note: to do what you said you would do
cards.tip: 反义是 break a promise（食言）；promise 可数，答应过很多事就说 keep your promises。
cards.example: If you can't keep a promise, tell people early.

cards.note: if something slips your mind, you forget it
开发团队每天的简短碰头会，大家站着开，几分钟结束，也叫 daily stand-up。
responsible for a person, group or piece of work
cards.tip: 管事、管人都能用：in charge of the interns 就是「负责带实习生」；「这事归我管」就说 I'm in charge。
cards.example: She's in charge of hiring new developers.

cards.note: 英式口语，指私下简短地谈，有时带一点提醒的意思：Can I have a word with you?
be surrounded by sth / sb；动词 surround 是「包围」。
to say firmly that you will do something, or that something must happen
cards.tip: on 后面接名词或 doing：insist on finishing，不说 insist to finish。
cards.example: My manager insisted on paying for lunch.

cards.note: alone, or without help from anyone
to be annoyed or bored with something that has gone on for too long
cards.tip: with 后面接人、事或 doing；fed up with myself 是「对自己恼火、受够了自己」。
cards.example: I'm fed up with meetings that could be emails.

cards.note: 也常叫 Post-it（品牌名）；stick 是「粘」。

cards.zh: 恐怕；（客气地说出坏消息）
cards.note: used to politely say something that the other person may not want to hear
cards.tip: 不是「我害怕」，而是让拒绝和坏消息听起来客气些；简短回答可以说 I'm afraid not.（恐怕不行）
cards.example: I'm afraid the meeting room is booked all afternoon.

cards.note: used to introduce a reason or a problem
cards.tip: 用来引出理由或难处，后面加逗号；比直接说 because 柔和，听起来像在解释，不像在找借口。
cards.example: I'd love to come. The thing is, I've got a deadline on Friday.

cards.note: to spend time doing, making or improving something
in addition to something, especially something difficult
cards.tip: 既能说位置（on top of the fridge 冰箱顶上），也常说「在…之外又加上」，多用来说事情多、压力大。
cards.example: On top of the release, we have three new people to train.

cards.note: to tell someone that you need them to help you
to say no to a request or an offer
cards.tip: 代词放中间：turn it down；比 refuse 委婉。另一个常见意思是「调小音量」：turn the music down。
cards.example: He turned down the job because the commute was too long.

cards.note: 提出请求是 make a request；也能当动词，但比 ask 正式。
to stop working or doing something for a short time
to help someone, especially with a practical job
